title: Thorn and Wolf
author: D. M. Oyelaran
blurb: Cyrus Zhou, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
